title: Arrived chipped
text: Arrived chipped. Two of the four bowls arrived chipped like this. they Only have a thin sheet of cardboard protecting each of them in the box.  They are super easy to clean and are big enough for any meal you could want in them. some of the small scratches on the sides that come from shipping were buffed out whit water and a dish sponge till they were only noticeable if you looked really closely at them. the grey bowls arnt a dark grey more of a light grey.
